messages:
incident-bot: [INCIDENT] INC-202803 — p95 inference latency > 2.0s on us-west-prod (runtime pool=gen-1). Paging SRE oncall @Dana S. Runbook: https://redwood.runbooks/inference/latency

Dana S: on it, grabbing logs + dashboard. Marking as paged.

Aisha Tan: seen similar blips earlier, could be KV cache misses after the deploy last night. Checking model routing and cache hit-rate.

Ben K.: I can spin a small extra dedicated pool if we need immediate capacity relief. ETA ~4m to attach. Good if traffic is load-spiky.

Dana S: please do Ben. Also starting mitigation checklist: 1) scale pool 2) enable fallback routing to smaller model-variant 3) silence noisy duplicates for 20m while we stabilize.

Carlos M: customer-facing impact? I talked to Support — a handful of slow requests, no errors returned, just latency. No escalations yet.

Aisha Tan: looking at metrics now — cache_hit_rate dropped from 92% -> 60% around 18:21 UTC. p95 spiked to 2.4s. suspect KV cache eviction after noisy long sequences.

Dana S: Ben, go ahead with the extra pool. Aisha, can you flip on prefix caching for that model group (if safe) and reduce max_seq for the heavy-traffic route?

Ben K.: extra pool attached to gen-1. throughput back up. Link: https://console.redwood/pools/gen-1

incident-bot: [AUTOMATION] Increased gen-1 capacity by +2 nodes (autoscale).

Aisha Tan: toggled prefix caching and lowered max_seq from 4096 -> 2048 for route /api/v1/generate-heavy (temporary). Monitoring.

Dana S: doing a quick sanity query:
```
# prometheus quick check
curl -s "https://metrics.redwood/api/v1/query?query=p95_inference_latency{env=prod, pool=gen-1}" | jq .data.result
```
output: p95=1.05s (after scale + cache change)

Carlos M: great — any need to open a maintenance window or silence alerts? I can coordinate via monitoring.

Dana S: yes, planning to silence the noisy alert rule for 30m and create a temporary maintenance window for gen-1 for 60m while we validate. Doing silence now: `/silence alert:inference_latency_gen1 30m reason:"mitigation during incident"`

incident-bot: [ACTION] Silence created: alert:inference_latency_gen1 — 30m — created by Dana S

Ben K.: confirm load looks normal after scale. p95 trending ~1.1s and request rate normal.

Aisha Tan: backend logs show a spike of requests with long prefixes from a single client-id — throttled that client via rate-limit rule for now. Will open a follow-up with infra to block or quarantine if it repeats.

Carlos M: thanks — I pushed a quick note to Support to watch for escalation. No customer-visible errors, so I'll mark customer impact as minimal for now.

Dana S: marking incident mitigated at 1802346200. Leaving silence/maint window active until we validate thresholds and re-run eval traffic.

Dana S: post-mit notes — we need to adjust alerting and dashboards to reduce noise next time. Current alert fires on absolute p95 > 1.5s for whole pool; that’s noisy when transient cache misses hit a subset. Proposal:
- change alert to p95 by route/model-tag (split heavy vs light)
- add sustained window: alert only if p95 > X for 3m rolling
- add cache_hit_rate as a secondary condition (don't page if cache_hit_rate < 70% unless p95 > 3.0s)

Aisha Tan: agree. Also add a dashboard tile showing cache_hit_rate alongside latency and a heatmap of client-ids producing long prefixes.

Ben K.: ops side — create a managed maintenance window in Monitoring for gen-1 when we roll config changes. Also add autoscaling headroom metric to the alert so we don't page when autoscale is already spinning.

Carlos M: I'll own validating user impact and communicating any follow-up to Support.

Dana S: action items: 
- Aisha -> implement split alerts and dashboard tiles (PR + screenshot) — due EOD tomorrow
- Ben -> add autoscale headroom condition and maintenance window template (PR) — due 48h
- Carlos -> customer impact summary + Support note — due EOD today
- Dana -> run a replay test tomorrow morning at low-traffic and validate new thresholds against synthetic load.

Aisha Tan: quick note on threshold numbers — propose p95 thresholds: heavy routes 2.2s, light routes 1.2s, sustained window 3m. Will include these in the PR.

Dana S: sounds reasonable. Also schedule a 30m retro tomorrow 10:00 UTC to review the runbook steps and make sure the runbook has the prefix-caching toggle documented.

incident-bot: [INCIDENT UPDATE] INC-202803 marked mitigated by Dana S at 1802346200. Follow-ups assigned.

Carlos M: thanks team. Small customer impact, mitigation worked quick, follow-ups are scoped. Leaving the temporary silence until we confirm alert behavior tomorrow. :thumbsup:

Dana S: closing thread here, will post the incident summary doc after the retro. If anyone sees repeat traffic pattern, ping me immediately.

Aisha Tan: noted. I'll include a sample query in the PR to validate during the replay: `query=p95_inference_latency{route="/api/v1/generate-heavy"}`

Ben K.: thanks — will add autoscale logs to the dashboard so we can correlate scale events with latency spikes.

Carlos M: closing on my side.
